intent.scope: Templates frozen on SLR0; exact recovery uses evaluation-derived per-instance exceptions or explicit fallback. This is not prediction without access to the device database.

traversal.scope: Templates frozen on SLR0; exact recovery uses evaluation-derived per-instance exceptions or explicit fallback. This is not prediction without access to the device database.

traversal_equal_budget.scope: Templates frozen on SLR0; exact recovery uses evaluation-derived per-instance exceptions or explicit fallback. This is not prediction without access to the device database.

limitations: Evaluation exceptions and fallback use true device adjacency; not database-free prediction.
Traversal full training has more rows than intent; equal-budget hash subset is exploratory, not preregistered.
No cross-SLR conductor occurs in this new domain; prior real samples cover that semantic case.
Each native variant runs sequentially in a separate pinned process; no randomized process order or statistical CI.
First query timings follow exhaustive validation dump, so OS/CPU caches are not cold. Resident repeats retain the LRU.
Process RSS includes executable, allocator/container overhead, input, dump validation, queries and result storage; not isolated accelerator memory.
Static file bytes include all alias/property/index/audit tables and 64-byte padding; graph vector stays resident even in expanded mode.
State and cache payload counts exclude container metadata; process peak RSS is the observed full-process bound.
Logical record bytes are software accounting, not measured DRAM traffic. No FPGA board or whole-router speedup claimed.
